notes.title: On release 22nd September 2023
notes.notes:
Programming and internal playtest phase has been completed, the game is in the beta-test phase and will be released on September 22, 2023.
Add it to your wishlist and try it to know our main character Annelise, who makes her debut in the gaming world.
Annelise will be the protagonist of the demo 'The Pyrite Talisman', arriving in the next few months and if there is sufficient interest, of the full game Telluria: Forebodings, scheduled for the end of 2024.
